false_assumption.statement: Wild Rose McLean was the murderer because her glove was found at the crime scene.
false_assumption.why_it_seems_reasonable: The glove with a rose embroidery was found at the scene, and Wild Rose was known to be present in the apartment shortly before the murder. Her passionate anger towards James Cunningham also provided a plausible motive.
false_assumption.what_it_hides: The glove was left inadvertently and taken by Kirby Lane, and Wild Rose was not capable of the complex murder involving chloroform and tying up the victim.

mechanism_description: Shibo Horikawa, the Japanese valet, killed James Cunningham, Sr. by chloroforming him, tying him to a chair, and then shooting him at close range. He also killed Horikawa to silence him. Shibo acted out of self-preservation after Cunningham discovered his plan to steal money and frame others.

discriminating_test.design: Reconstruct the timeline of arrivals and departures at the apartment using witness testimonies and physical evidence such as glove presence, time on watches, and presence on fire escape. Verify the presence of suspects in the apartment during the critical murder window and check for contradictions in alibis and testimonies.
discriminating_test.knowledge_revealed: This test reveals who had the opportunity to commit the murder within the narrow time window and who was lying about their presence or actions.
discriminating_test.pass_condition: The suspect must be proven to have been present in the apartment during the murder time window with no credible alibi and with access to the murder method.
